name: Dran Sword
description: The original BEYBLADE X attacker: three upper blades built to drive opponents upward while the Flat bit hunts for Xtreme Dash opportunities.

name: Hells Scythe
description: A versatile Balance combo whose four smash blades and Taper bit mix aggressive movement with steadier finishing.

name: Wizard Arrow
description: Two broad blades push weight outward for centrifugal Stamina, and the Ball bit keeps it calm in the centre.

name: Knight Shield
description: Six damping blades absorb incoming strikes while the Needle bit holds the centre of the stadium.

name: Knight Lance
description: A taller Defense setup: a sturdy lance-like blade paired with the High Needle bit for stable positioning.

name: Shark Edge
description: An upper-attack blade on a low profile with the Low Flat bit for fast, sharp Xtreme Dashes.

name: Leon Claw
description: A Balance blade with claw-like contact points paired with the all-rounder Point bit.

name: Rhino Horn
description: A compact, inward-weighted Defense blade on a Spike bit, designed to shrug off strong hits.

name: Dran Dagger
description: An Attack blade on the Rush bit, whose ten-tooth gear trades raw dash speed for more frequent rail contact.

name: Hells Chain
description: A Balance combo with a chain-link blade and High Taper bit for controlled, mid-speed movement.

name: Phoenix Wing
description: A heavy, metal-rich Attack blade with Gear Flat for explosive Xtreme Dash potential.

name: Dranzer Spiral
description: A legacy-inspired Balance blade with two horizontal blades for striking power and endurance.

name: Driger Slash
description: A legacy-inspired Balance blade whose slashing edges pair with the neutral Point bit.

name: Unicorn Sting
description: A dual-mode Balance blade with both attack and defense edges; behaviour shifts with launch style.

name: Tyranno Beat
description: A heavy smash-attack blade with the Quake bit, which produces erratic, hard-hitting movement.

name: Weiss Tiger
description: Upper, damper and smash blades on one Balance blade, with the multi-behaviour Unite bit.

name: Cobalt Dragoon
description: A left-spin upper attacker with four heavy blades and the spiral Cyclone bit.

name: Black Shell
description: A shell-shaped Defense blade on the Dot bit, focused on deflecting attacks.

name: Crimson Garuda
description: A Balance blade with the Trans Point bit for adaptable movement.

name: Draciel Shield
description: A legacy-inspired Defense blade with rounded contact points and the Dot bit.

name: Xeno Xcalibur
description: A legacy-inspired Attack blade with long sword-like blades on the Gear Flat bit.

name: Storm Pegasis
description: A legacy-inspired Attack blade on the grippy Rubber Accel bit.

name: Tricera Press
description: An inward-weighted Defense blade on the tall M-85 ratchet and bouncy Bound Spike bit.

name: Samurai Calibur
description: A Balance blade with the Merge bit, blending grip and stability.

name: Dran Strike
description: Six heavyweight blades with metal extending inward, riding the free-spinning Free Flat bit.

name: Dran Buster
description: A single-blade Unique Line attacker concentrating weight into one massive hit, with the Accel bit.

name: Hells Hammer
description: Thick smash blades aimed at slamming opponents down, stabilised by the six-sided Hexa bit.

name: Wizard Rod
description: A wide, outward-weighted Stamina blade with the Disk Ball bit to maximise centrifugal force.

name: Shinobi Shadow
description: Three smooth blades built to parry attacks, on a Metal Needle bit.

name: Aero Pegasus
description: A heavy Unique Line Attack blade on the Accel bit.

name: Leon Crest
description: A Defense blade with a heavy crest ring, paired with Gear Needle for occasional dashes.

name: Phoenix Rudder
description: A Stamina blade paired with the Glide bit for smooth, low-friction spin.

name: Silver Wolf
description: A high-stamina blade with the free-spinning Free Ball bit.

name: Samurai Saber
description: A Unique Line attacker paired with the Level bit.

name: Impact Drake
description: One of the highest-attack blades, paired with the aggressive Low Rush bit.

name: Golem Rock
description: A rugged Defense blade on a low Under Needle bit.

name: Scorpio Spear
description: A transforming blade that shifts from a defensive six-blade form to a three-blade attack form after dashing.

name: Shark Scale
description: A high-attack Unique Line blade on a very low Under Flat bit.

name: Meteor Dragoon
description: A left-spin Unique Line attacker with the Jolt bit.

name: Dran Brave

name: Wizard Arc
description: A Custom Line Stamina build with the Round assist blade and Low Orb bit.

name: Perseus Dark
description: A Custom Line Defense build with the Bumper assist blade and anti-tilt Wedge bit.

name: Hells Reaper
description: Rapid-smash Custom Line Balance build with the reversible Turn assist blade.

name: Sol Eclipse
description: A Custom Line Balance build with the Dual assist blade and Trans Kick bit.

name: Wolf Hunt
description: A Custom Line Stamina build with the Free assist blade and Disk Ball bit.

name: Phoenix Flare
description: A Custom Line Defense build with the Zillion assist blade and the Wall Wedge bit.

name: Bahamut Blitz
description: An expanded Custom Line attacker: Break over blade, Blitz metal blade, Knuckle assist and Ignition bit.

name: Knight Fortress
description: An expanded Custom Line Defense build: Guard over blade, Fortress metal blade and Vertical assist.

name: Ragna Rage
description: An expanded Custom Line Stamina build: Flow over blade, Rage metal blade, Erase assist and Yielding bit.
